truth_boundary: This matrix describes the release product surface only. Foundation-only systems are explicitly excluded from user-facing release claims rather than promoted by documentation.

rows.permission_boundary: No elevated authority; tool/remote side effects remain separately gated
rows.persistence_behavior: Room history persists through canonical room persistence

rows.trigger: New chat / named room / room item / delete
rows.permission_boundary: Room deletion requires user confirmation; active generation cannot be deleted
rows.persistence_behavior: IndexedDB-backed canonical state with local migration/fallback path

rows.surface: Composer, assistant retry control, Coding workspace task bar
rows.trigger: Stop / Retry last / continue by sending the next turn in the same room
rows.permission_boundary: Cancellation never grants authority and does not imply remote side effects were reversed
rows.persistence_behavior: Conversation continuation remains in the active room; transient generation state is not falsely persisted as success

rows.permission_boundary: Selection cannot promote an unproven paid/unknown model into verified-free eligibility
rows.persistence_behavior: Selected model persists in settings

rows.surface: Settings > Free Model Routing / fallback / provider controls
rows.permission_boundary: Strict free-proof and explicit-provider-enable rules remain authoritative
rows.persistence_behavior: Routing/provider preferences persist; transient health/cooldown state is bounded

rows.surface: Settings model list + model-dependent reasoning/output controls + Free Model Fabric status
rows.trigger: Open settings or change selected model
rows.permission_boundary: Provider/model metadata remains descriptive and cannot create authority
rows.persistence_behavior: Profile is recomputed from the current catalog; only user preferences persist

rows.runtime_target: SevenControl adaptive budget + SevenPerformance tier governor
rows.permission_boundary: Degradation may reduce optional depth, never safety/verification floors
rows.persistence_behavior: Transient compute/tier state; no false durable quality claim

rows.runtime_target: Deep Think request path / reasoning-aware provider route
rows.permission_boundary: Reasoning depth does not change tool permission authority
rows.persistence_behavior: User preference is retained by existing settings state

rows.permission_boundary: Search results remain evidence/discovery input, not action authority
rows.persistence_behavior: Conversation results persist; transient fetch state does not

rows.surface: Composer attachment control + Settings knowledge list
rows.runtime_target: Knowledge artifact extraction/rebuild + lazy local PDF runtime
rows.permission_boundary: User-selected local files only; extracted text does not gain authority over source
rows.persistence_behavior: Knowledge artifacts are room-bound; original bytes are not falsely claimed as durable storage

rows.surface: Chat context behavior + Settings pinned notes/knowledge controls
rows.trigger: Message execution and explicit pinned-note/knowledge changes
rows.permission_boundary: Recall/context placement cannot create permissions or increase source authority
rows.persistence_behavior: Authoritative room/settings state persists; derived context remains reconstructable

rows.runtime_target: SevenCodingWorkspace + SevenRuntime codingMap + real chat execution
rows.permission_boundary: Read/inspect/context are real; unsupported shell/device writes stay disabled and explicitly bounded
rows.persistence_behavior: Attached project context becomes room knowledge only after persistence succeeds

rows.permission_boundary: Evidence/freshness/conflict status cannot be promoted into user authority
rows.persistence_behavior: Research output may persist in conversation; ephemeral fetch progress does not

rows.permission_boundary: Model prose proposes; verified world/canon controllers own committed state
rows.persistence_behavior: World/canon/session state follows canonical runtime persistence boundaries

rows.surface: Typed result surfaces requested by specialist/runtime flows
rows.permission_boundary: Schema-bound DOM only; generated content cannot inject arbitrary executable HTML
rows.persistence_behavior: Rendered view is derived; authoritative source data remains elsewhere

rows.permission_boundary: Pixels/OCR/VLM observations remain derived evidence and cannot grant authority
rows.persistence_behavior: NOT_APPLICABLE
rows.rationale: Vision Fabric foundation is verified, but live OCR/VLM acquisition is explicitly partial. Seven must not expose or market a dead image-input control in this release state.

rows.surface: Contextual tool activity inside task/workspace flows
rows.trigger: Planner/runtime selects an eligible tool capability
rows.runtime_target: Tool registry + capability graph + invocation validation
rows.permission_boundary: Tool Security Kernel and exact argument/scope grants remain mandatory
rows.persistence_behavior: Tool/effect evidence is ledger-bound where applicable

rows.surface: Task/tool error, permission and verification states
rows.trigger: Effectful tool request or uncertain result
rows.runtime_target: Tool Security Kernel + Side-Effect Ledger + SevenExecution
rows.permission_boundary: Original user grant is authoritative; tool/model echoes cannot escalate it
rows.persistence_behavior: Effect ledger/checkpoints preserve dispatch/effect uncertainty

rows.permission_boundary: Derived data cannot gain authority by repetition, summary or corroboration alone
rows.persistence_behavior: Evidence lineage survives derived transformations where stored

rows.runtime_target: Verification Plan/Judge receipts and commit gate
rows.permission_boundary: Missing evidence cannot become PASS
rows.persistence_behavior: Evidence/receipts are artifact/run bound

rows.surface: Coding workspace offers bounded project-file inspection, not the planned full persistent Projects product
rows.permission_boundary: Protected paths and user-authorized file scope remain authoritative
rows.persistence_behavior: Full persistent Projects system is not claimed in this release candidate
rows.rationale: The full persistent Projects product remains partial; only the verified Coding workspace/file-context subset is release-relevant.

rows.surface: Settings > Export / Import plus automatic IndexedDB persistence
rows.runtime_target: Canonical backup payload + transactional room persistence
rows.permission_boundary: Import validates canonical state before apply; secrets are outside room backup authority
rows.persistence_behavior: IndexedDB canonical room state with guarded import/export

rows.runtime_target: Provider streaming normalization and guarded cancellation path
rows.permission_boundary: Cancellation cannot claim a remote side effect was undone without verification
rows.persistence_behavior: Only accepted conversation result is committed; stopped output is not promoted as completed

rows.surface: Settings theme control + automatic Day/Night identity
rows.trigger: toggleTheme / theme preference / platform time-theme behavior
rows.runtime_target: Theme state + frozen Seven identity assets
rows.permission_boundary: Presentation only; no authority effect
rows.persistence_behavior: Theme preference persists

rows.permission_boundary: Presentation preferences never alter correctness/authority
rows.persistence_behavior: User/system preferences are respected across reload where applicable

rows.surface: Android file/native operations only when invoked by an eligible user flow
rows.permission_boundary: SAF content URI scope and platform authorization are mandatory; no broad filesystem authority
rows.persistence_behavior: Persisted URI grants/secure material follow Android platform rules
rows.test/evidence_ref: release/android-native-platform-bridge.test.cjs; Android instrumentation in Seven Android APK workflow

rows.surface: Whole product with tier-aware visual/compute degradation
rows.permission_boundary: Performance downgrades cannot disable safety/permission/verification invariants
rows.persistence_behavior: Pressure state is transient; preferences remain separate

rows.permission_boundary: Must not expose private reasoning or unredacted sensitive data
rows.persistence_behavior: Partial/diagnostic only
rows.rationale: Full observability is explicitly partial and is not advertised as a release user feature.

rows.permission_boundary: Candidate changes cannot self-promote without eval/promotion gates
rows.persistence_behavior: Artifact/eval-bound
rows.rationale: Self-evolution promotion is engineering infrastructure, not an end-user control in this release.
